summary.headline: Judging Royal Favor and Reputation
summary.text: Astrological rules for judging royal favor, reputation, dignity, power, and the native’s relation to kings from applications between the lords of the ascendant and midheaven, their angular or cadent positions, and aspects. The text continues by directing attention to the Sun when no application exists between those lords.
